name: Lago Verde village to the km-5.5 camp (GPT28H start)
dist: about 11 km return (about 8 km if turned at the private-property sign at km 4)
terrain: Minor gravel road for about 4 km, then trail through a settlement; stream water; no fords before km 13
cost: free; fuel and a long gravel drive (X-10, about 70 km from La Junta)
caution: private-land (sign at km 4; farm crossing km 6 to 10 needed permission in Feb 2026), navigation; dead-end village; only worth it if the plan visits Lago Verde anyway
why: Quiet border village walk; the plateau beyond is not recommended because of the landowner issue and fords
